title: The Conservative Advantage
partTitle: There's More to Morality than Harm and Fairness
frozenBasis: Official table of contents confirms chapter title and placement.

supportablePoints: Chapter 8 likely argues that conservatives often communicate across a broader set of moral registers than liberals.
